files.README.md:
# The harbor shop

This folder is your workspace. Over the quest you will:
  1. run other people's images (nginx, redis, alpine)
  2. package this shop app into your own image
  3. start the shop and its database together with Compose
  4. ship it all to a Kubernetes cluster

Type help to see the commands this playground understands.
files.Dockerfile:
# Start from a small official Node.js image
FROM node:20-alpine

# Work inside /app in the image
WORKDIR /app

# Copy the dependency list first. It changes rarely, so this layer caches well.
COPY package.json .
RUN npm install

# Now copy the app code and the message
COPY app.js message.txt ./

# Document the port the app listens on, and say how to start it
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "app.js"]
files.compose.yaml:
# Two services that start together with one command
services:
  web:
    build: .              # build the image from the Dockerfile here
    image: shop:compose
    ports:
      - "4000:3000"       # laptop port : container port
    environment:
      REDIS_HOST: cache   # reach the other service by its name
    depends_on:
      - cache
  cache:
    image: redis:7
    volumes:
      - cache-data:/data  # keep the visit counter on a volume

volumes:
  cache-data:
files.shop.yaml:
# Three Kubernetes objects in one file, separated by ---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: shop-config
  namespace: shop
data:
  GREETING: "Welcome to the harbor shop"
  CURRENCY: "EUR"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: shop
  namespace: shop
spec:
  replicas: 4
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: shop
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: shop
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: nginx:1.27
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: shop-config
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: shop
  namespace: shop
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: shop
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80
